text.description_html:
Acorn RTHBR, Bean Tip Rim Latch Rough Black Iron

The Rough Iron Bean Tip Privacy Rim Latchset has a textured finish that is great for adding historic old world charm to your doors. The Bean Tip Rim Latch Rough Black Iron is most often used on gates or doors that do not need to be locked. The Rim Latch Set has a flip down locking device for privacy. It will fit doors with 7/8 inch to 1-3/4 inch thicknesses.

Rough Black Iron: A rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the naturally weathered iron.

Also available Smooth Black Iron Bean Rim Latch Set

Specifications: of the Bean Tip Privacy Rim Latchset:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of the Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 6-3/4"
  • Handle Width: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
